in_marathi.name: Induprabha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Jewel of Indu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Induprabha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Induprabha is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Indu’ meaning ‘moon’ and ‘Prabha’ meaning ‘jewel’ or ‘light’. The name Induprabha signifies the one who is the embodiment of the radiant light of the moon god. This name is often given to a girl born during the full moon night, symbolizing the divine blessings of the moon god.
